auth_definition: true/false/null means current AWCC OEM challenge-response enabled/disabled/unknown, not hardware security capability or vendor intent.
controller_definition: AWCC software controller class is evidence of transport selection; not physical chip die identification.
report_length_definition: USB wire payload excluding synthetic HID API report-ID byte. hid_api_buffer_length includes that byte. Native AWCC control path does not prepend it.
